design.issue: ISSUE C: the gated graph has no operator gate after planning. `plan` returns stack.json and `implement` starts with no notification, no approval, and no way to request changes; the only human node is the release gate. The engine models a human answer as a bare boolean with a static question, so a plan gate cannot show the frozen plan or carry feedback back to the planner. In any non-TUI mode (print / no dialog UI) a human gate is answered by the harness stub (confirm → false) instead of stopping NEEDS_HUMAN with a resume command.
design.root_cause: Three gaps, one per layer. (1) Topology: packages/coding-agent/src/kpi/graphs/coding-loop.gated.json edge L192-195 is `plan → implement` unconditional; the single human node (L139-144) sits after review. (2) Engine: `HumanGraphNode` (graph/schema.ts L49-55) is `{title, question, statePath}` only; `submitHuman(approved: boolean)` (graph/engine.ts L1459-1492) writes one boolean at statePath and nothing else; `nodePrompt` (L697-713) substitutes only `{{job_id}}`, so a re-run planner (isolated session, no memory) can never see operator feedback. (3) Driver: gated-loop.ts answers every pending human with `ctx.ui.confirm(pending.title, pending.question)` in two duplicated loops (L1690-1726 resume path, L1932-1975 first run) and never checks `ctx.hasUI`; the no-UI stub (core/extensions/runner.ts L236-239) returns `confirm → false`, `select → undefined`, so a gate in print mode is silently denied and routed by `policy.onHumanDeny` rather than stopping for the operator. No bell/attention API exists in packages/tui/src (every `\x07` hit is OSC parsing), so "notify" today is only the board turning protocol-blue via `pending_question` (gated-loop.ts L464 → control-plane.ts L232 → board.ts L407-418).

change.what: Add next to DuneStack (after the type block ending L36): `export const PLAN_SUMMARY_MAX_MODULES = 12;` and `export function renderPlanSummary(stack: DuneStack): string` — pure, no I/O. Lines joined with \n: `Delivery: <delivery>` (+ ` — <delivery_reason>` when present); `Root: <root>`; `Current slice: <current_module_id>` or `Current slice: (none named — implement will refuse this map)`; `Modules (<n>):`; per module (first PLAN_SUMMARY_MAX_MODULES) `  <i>. <id> — <purpose>` and `     folder <folder> · interface <interface> · <k> allowed path(s) · depends on <a, b|nothing>`; if more, `  … and <n-12> more modules (see stack.json)`. No new module: stack.ts owns DuneStack/assertDuneStack/readDuneStack (L8-36, L249, L434) and is already imported by engine.ts (L20) and gated-loop.ts (L34).

HumanGraphNode (L49-55) gains `detail?: "stack.json"` (the run file whose summary the driver shows with the question; the one file that has a renderer) and `feedbackPath?: string` (state path the operator's change request is written to on denial). AgentGraphNode gains `feedbackPath?: string` (state path whose non-empty string is appended to this node's prompt). Add `export interface HumanAnswer { approved: boolean; feedback?: string }`. PendingHumanInput (L183-187) is unchanged.

(a) validateNode human branch (L218-224): if `value.detail !== undefined` it must equal "stack.json" else throw `human node ${id}.detail must be stack.json, the only run file with a summary renderer`; if `feedbackPath` present assertString + assertStatePath. Agent branch (L230+): `feedbackPath` optional, assertString + assertStatePath. (b) nodePrompt(node) (L697-713): after the Run-directory lines, when `node.feedbackPath` is set and `getStatePath(this.runState.values, node.feedbackPath)` is a non-empty string, push `""`, `Operator feedback on your previous response (node run ${this.runState.nodes[node.id].runs}):`, the feedback text, `Address every point, then return the corrected JSON only.` (runs was already incremented for this run at L1330, so the second run reads `node run 2`). (c) `submitHuman(answer: HumanAnswer)` (L1459) replaces the boolean: same pending/node checks; `setStatePath(values, node.statePath, answer.approved)`; if `answer.feedback !== undefined && node.feedbackPath === undefined` throw `human node ${node.id} accepts no feedback`; if `node.feedbackPath !== undefined && !answer.approved`: `const feedback = answer.feedback?.trim() ?? ""`, empty → throw `human node ${node.id} was denied without feedback`, else `setStatePath(values, node.feedbackPath, feedback)`. Rest of routing unchanged (refreshFacts, route, terminate/fail, checkpoint). (d) `resume(answer: HumanAnswer)` (L1489). (e) Delete `GraphHumanUI` (L109-111) and `resumeWithUI` (L1494-1500): no callers. interrupt (L1281-1299) is unchanged — the engine does no stack.json I/O.

Plan node (L37-56) gains `"feedbackPath": "plan.feedback"`. Insert after plan-check a new node `{"id":"plan-approval","type":"human","title":"Plan approval","question":"The plan is frozen as stack.json. Approve it for implementation, or request changes?","statePath":"plan.approved","detail":"stack.json","feedbackPath":"plan.feedback"}`. Replace edge {plan → implement} (L192-195) with three edges: `{from: plan, to: plan-approval}`; `{from: plan-approval, to: implement, when: {path: plan.approved, equals: true}}`; `{from: plan-approval, to: plan, when: {path: plan.approved, equals: false}}`. `plan-check → implement` stays: on the --plan path the operator authored the frozen plan and plan-check writes no stack.json. The revision bound is the existing per-node cap (budget.ts L135-149, checked at engine.ts L1275 before a node starts): the third change request routes to plan with runs=3 ≥ cap 3 and the run ends EXHAUSTED with `exhausted_limit: maxRounds` and reason `node plan exhausted maxRounds 3 after 3 runs`. coding-loop.auto.json and spec-first.json are untouched.

(a) Docstring L80-86 + `LoopRecovery` (L87) become `"provider" | "delivery" | "approval"` ('… or a human gate that needs an interactive session to answer'); recoveryReason (L664-670) advice for approval: `Answer it in an interactive K-π session`. control-plane.ts adds no branch: its generic notify (L494-497) already prints the reason with the resume command; only `provider` gets an extra confirm. (b) Export `PLAN_GATE_OPTIONS = ["Approve plan", "Request changes"] as const` and `MAX_HUMAN_FEEDBACK_CHARS = 4000`. No 'View full plan' option: the dialog names the file path instead. (c) New `async function answerPendingHuman(engine, graph, ctx, jobDirectory, eventsPath, task, stopState, onStateChange): Promise<DriveResult | undefined>` replacing the bodies of both duplicated loops (L1690-1726 and L1932-1975; each becomes `while (result.state.status === "interrupted") { const stopped = await answerPendingHuman(...); if (stopped !== undefined) { await writeTerminalState(...); [await onStateChange?.()]; return {jobId, status: stopped.terminalStatus, reason, recovery, graphState} } result = await driveUntilPause(...); if (result.terminalStatus !== undefined) {…unchanged…} }`; the first-run `resumed.status === "completed"` break is subsumed by the while condition). Behaviour: `pending = engine.state.pendingHuman` (throw the existing 'Interrupted graph has no pending human approval' if absent); `node = graph.nodes.find(n => n.id === pending.nodeId)`, throw `pending human node does not exist: ${id}` unless type human; `ctx.ui.notify(\`K-π job ${jobId} is waiting on you: ${pending.title}\`, "warning")` (no bell: the TUI exposes none); if `!ctx.hasUI` return `{state: engine.state, stopState, terminalStatus: "NEEDS_HUMAN", recovery: "approval", reason: recoveryReason("approval", \`${pending.title} needs an interactive session\`, jobId)}` — engine stays interrupted with pendingHuman intact, state.json keeps pending_question (board stays protocol-blue), resume re-asks. If `node.feedbackPath === undefined`: `approved = await ctx.ui.confirm(pending.title, pending.question)` exactly as today, answer `{approved}`. Else the gate loop: `summary = node.detail === undefined ? "" : await readDuneStack(jobDirectory).then(renderPlanSummary).catch(e => \`${node.detail} could not be summarised: ${message(e)}\`)` (recorded in the dialog and as a warning notify; never fatal — the operator can still request changes); `runs = engine.state.nodes[pending.nodeId].runs`, `cap = Math.min(engine.limits.maxRounds, engine.limits.maxNodeRuns)`; `title = [pending.title, pending.question, "", summary, "", \`Full plan: .kpi/runs/${jobId}/${node.detail}\` (only when detail), \`Revision ${runs} of ${cap}${runs >= cap ? " — a further change request ends the job EXHAUSTED" : ""}\`].join("\n")`; `choice = await ctx.ui.select(title, [...PLAN_GATE_OPTIONS])`; `undefined` → return the NEEDS_HUMAN DriveResult with message `${pending.title} was dismissed`; `Request changes` → `text = await ctx.ui.editor(\`Request changes to ${node.detail ?? "the plan"}\`, previous ?? "")`; undefined → re-ask; trimmed empty → `notify("Feedback is required to request plan changes", "warning")` and re-ask; `text.trim().length > MAX_HUMAN_FEEDBACK_CHARS` → `notify(\`Feedback must be at most ${MAX_HUMAN_FEEDBACK_CHARS} characters (got ${n})\`, "warning")`, keep `previous = text`, re-ask; otherwise answer `{approved: false, feedback: text.trim()}`; `Approve plan` → `{approved: true}`. Then `appendEvent(eventsPath, {ts, type: "approval.result", job_id, round: stopState.round, node: pending.nodeId, approved: answer.approved, question: pending.question, ...(answer.feedback === undefined ? {} : {feedback: answer.feedback})})`, `await engine.submitHuman(answer)`, `await writeState(jobDirectory, task, engine.state, stopState)`, `await onStateChange?.()`, return undefined. (d) stageFor (L418-426): `plan-approval` → `plan`. (e) stateDocument (L428-485) is unchanged: nothing reads a plan object or a summary from state.json (board reads pending_question only; resume reads the engine checkpoint, where plan.approved/plan.feedback live exactly like release.approved).

Regenerated by the script only; never hand-edited.
Rebuild packages/coding-agent so dist/kpi/graphs/coding-loop.gated.json and dist/kpi/schemas/event.schema.json are byte-for-byte copies (test/harness.test.ts L238-254).

event_or_data_contracts: Graph JSON, human node: optional `detail: "stack.json"` (read by the gated-loop driver only; validated to that one value) and optional `feedbackPath: <state path>` (packages/coding-agent/src/kpi/extensions/graph/schema.ts HumanGraphNode).

Graph JSON, agent node: optional `feedbackPath: <state path>`; when the run state holds a non-empty string there, nodePrompt appends `Operator feedback on your previous response (node run N):` + text + `Address every point, then return the corrected JSON only.`

Engine API: `export interface HumanAnswer { approved: boolean; feedback?: string }` (schema.ts); `GraphEngine.submitHuman(answer: HumanAnswer)` and `GraphEngine.resume(answer: HumanAnswer)` replace the boolean forms; `GraphHumanUI` and `resumeWithUI` are removed. Denial of a node with feedbackPath without non-empty feedback throws `human node <id> was denied without feedback`; feedback for a node without feedbackPath throws `human node <id> accepts no feedback`.

Checkpoint / GraphRunState values written by the plan-approval node: `plan.approved: boolean` and `plan.feedback: string` (trimmed, on denial). `values.plan` also carries `plan.provided` from the facts resolver, so its shape is `{ provided: boolean; approved?: boolean; feedback?: string }`. PendingHumanInput is unchanged; no summary is checkpointed.

state.json (gated-loop stateDocument): no new fields; `recovery` may now be `"approval"` (LoopRecovery = provider | delivery | approval); `pending_question` stays the one-line question the board renders.

Event `approval.result`: payload `{ approved: boolean; question?: string; feedback?: string }`; the plan gate emits one per answer with `node: "plan-approval"` (approved:false carries the trimmed feedback, redacted like every event string); event.schema.json approvalResult gains `feedback` ($defs/text).

Terminal for an unanswerable gate: `NEEDS_HUMAN`, `recovery: "approval"`, reason `<title> needs an interactive session|was dismissed. Answer it in an interactive K-π session, then resume with /kpi <job id>`; one loop.terminal event with status NEEDS_HUMAN (as the provider path does today); engine stays `interrupted` with pendingHuman intact so resume re-asks.

Bound on plan revisions: the existing per-node cap min(maxRounds, maxNodeRuns) (default 3 plan runs = 2 accepted change requests); the third change request ends EXHAUSTED with `exhausted_limit: "maxRounds"` and reason `node plan exhausted maxRounds 3 after 3 runs`.

Exports from stack.ts: `renderPlanSummary(stack: DuneStack): string`, `PLAN_SUMMARY_MAX_MODULES = 12` — pure; rendered by the driver at ask time from `readDuneStack(jobDirectory)`; a read/validation failure is shown as `stack.json could not be summarised: <reason>` in the dialog and a warning notification.
Operator notification on every gate: `K-π job <job id> is waiting on you: <title>` at level warning, before the dialog (or before the NEEDS_HUMAN stop when there is no dialog UI).

tests.title: the gated loop asks the operator to approve the plan before implement and records the approval

tests.title: request changes re-plans with the operator's feedback and refuses empty feedback
tests.asserts: loopSessions with stacks [healthStack, healthStackRevised] (same module id `health`, purpose changed to `serve GET /health as api and server`) and prompts capture; select answers [Request changes, Request changes, Approve plan]; editor answers ["", "split health into api and server"]: a warning notification `Feedback is required to request plan changes`; executed lists plan twice and implement once, plan-approval never; the second prompt starting `plan\n` contains `Operator feedback on your previous response (node run 2):\nsplit health into api and server` and the first does not; approval.result events for plan-approval are [{approved:false, feedback:"split health into api and server"},{approved:true}]; latestCheckpoint values.plan deepEqual {provided:false, approved:true, feedback:"split health into api and server"}; stack.json on disk has modules[0].purpose === the revised purpose (the second plan's output, frozen by freezeCurrentSlice before implement); status DONE.

tests.title: the third change request ends EXHAUSTED naming the plan node cap
tests.asserts: select answers Request changes ×3 with non-empty feedback: executed counts plan exactly 3 times and implement 0; state.json status EXHAUSTED, exhausted_limit "maxRounds", reason matches /node plan exhausted maxRounds 3 after 3 runs/, recovery undefined; exactly one loop.terminal event with status EXHAUSTED; three approval.result records for plan-approval all approved:false; the third select title contains `Revision 3 of 3 — a further change request ends the job EXHAUSTED`.

tests.title: a plan gate without dialog UI stops NEEDS_HUMAN with the resume command and never answers itself
tests.asserts: context {hasUI:false, mode:"print"} whose select/confirm/editor throw if called: state.json status NEEDS_HUMAN, recovery "approval", reason contains `Plan approval needs an interactive session` and `resume with /kpi <jobId>`, graph_status "interrupted", pending_question equals the node question, stage "plan"; exactly one loop.terminal with status NEEDS_HUMAN; no approval.result event; implement never ran; notifications include `K-π job <id> is waiting on you: Plan approval` and `K-π job <id> NEEDS_HUMAN: Plan approval needs an interactive session` containing the resume command.

tests.title: a plan gate dismissed with Escape stops NEEDS_HUMAN, re-asks on resume, and an approved gate is never asked twice
tests.asserts: first run with select scripted to return undefined: NEEDS_HUMAN with reason /Plan approval was dismissed/ and recovery "approval", no approval.result; `resumeLoop(jobId, context)` with select answering Approve plan: selections gains exactly one `Plan approval`, implement executed, status DONE; a further `resumeLoop` on the finished job returns DONE without a select (selections length unchanged) and latestCheckpoint values.plan.approved stays true. Additionally, with a fresh fixture: answer Approve plan, then stop the run by a factory whose implement session throws once (existing transient pattern), resumeLoop again → selections still has one `Plan approval` (an answered gate is completed in the checkpoint and not re-asked).

tests.title: a denied human node with a feedback path writes the feedback and the re-run node reads it in its prompt
tests.asserts: graph: agent `draft` (feedbackPath draft.feedback, response-less) → human `check` (statePath draft.ok, feedbackPath draft.feedback) with edges check→draft when false, check→__end__ when true; run interrupts; resume({approved:false, feedback:"  tighter "}) writes values.draft.feedback === "tighter", routes back to draft, and the second draft prompt contains `Operator feedback on your previous response (node run 2):\ntighter`; the first prompt contained no `Operator feedback` line; on a fresh interrupt submitHuman({approved:false}) rejects /denied without feedback/ and submitHuman({approved:true, feedback:"x"}) on a human node without feedbackPath rejects /accepts no feedback/; validateGraphDefinition rejects a human node with feedbackPath `a..b` and one with `detail: "verdict.json"` (/detail must be stack.json/).

tests.title: the gated graph gates implement on plan approval and routes a change request back to plan
tests.asserts: loadNamedGraph(coding-loop.gated): node plan-approval is type human with statePath plan.approved, detail stack.json, feedbackPath plan.feedback; node plan has feedbackPath plan.feedback; fired(plan) == [plan-approval]; fired(plan-approval,{plan.approved:true}) == [implement]; fired(plan-approval,{plan.approved:false}) == [plan]; fired(plan-check) == [implement]; coding-loop.auto has no human node and no plan-approval id.

tests.title: the plan summary names delivery, the current slice, and every module's bounds from stack.json alone
tests.asserts: renderPlanSummary on a two-module horizontal stack with a reason yields lines `Delivery: horizontal — <reason>`, `Root: src`, `Current slice: auth`, `Modules (2):`, one numbered line per module with its purpose, and a bounds line with `2 allowed path(s)` and `depends on auth`; a stack without current_module_id renders `Current slice: (none named — implement will refuse this map)`; PLAN_SUMMARY_MAX_MODULES + 2 modules render exactly 12 numbered lines plus `… and 2 more modules (see stack.json)`; called with a plain object and no filesystem.

docs.section: US-02 — Start from a task (gated) (L104-114) and WF-01 (L436-443)
docs.what: Story: '...plans, shows me the plan and asks me to approve it or request changes, implements, tests, reviews, then asks me before commit.' Add `- **AC-02.8** After plan writes stack.json the graph pauses on the human node `plan-approval` (operator plan approval, distinct from the Dune structural plan gate of US-30); its dialog shows a rendered summary of stack.json (delivery, current slice, every module with folder, interface, allowed-path count, dependencies) and the file path, and offers Approve plan / Request changes; implement never runs before an approval is recorded as `approval.result` with `node: plan-approval`.`; `- **AC-02.9** Request changes requires non-empty feedback (at most 4000 characters), records it in `approval.result.feedback` and the run state `plan.feedback`, and re-runs plan with the feedback in its prompt; the re-planned stack.json replaces the old one and is frozen before implement.`; `- **AC-02.10** Plan revisions are bounded by the plan node's run cap min(maxRounds, maxNodeRuns) (default 3 runs); the change request that would exceed it ends EXHAUSTED naming the cap.`; `- **AC-02.11** A human gate reached without dialog UI, or dismissed, ends NEEDS_HUMAN with recovery `approval` and the exact resume command; it is never answered by the harness. An answered gate is persisted with the checkpoint and is not asked again on resume.` WF-01: `→ plan (stack.json) → plan-approval (operator: approve / request changes → plan) → implement`.

risks: Behaviour change for the existing release gate in non-TUI modes: today the stub confirm returns false and the run is routed by policy.onHumanDeny (revise → another implement round); after this change it stops NEEDS_HUMAN with recovery `approval`. This is the defect the issue names (a harness-answered gate), so it is intended, but it is visible to anyone driving gated jobs through print/RPC without a dialog handler.

A gated job started without a dialog UI still spends research/specify/plan cost before stalling at the gate (see open question 2); the stall is recoverable with the exact resume command and no work is lost.

Every gated job now emits one more approval.result and, for a no-UI stop, one loop.terminal NEEDS_HUMAN followed by a second terminal on resume — the same shape the provider NEEDS_HUMAN path already produces. README record counts (14 → 15) change in three places (L582, L669, L887). `graph_round` (max node runs) rises by one per plan revision; per-node caps are independent, so implement's own run budget is not reduced.

The revision bound reuses the plan node's run cap (default 3 runs). An operator who passes `--max-rounds 1` gets zero change requests: the first Request changes ends EXHAUSTED. The dialog states `Revision N of cap` so this is visible, but it couples plan revisions to the same flag as verifier rounds (open question 1).

stack.json is rewritten on re-plan; an operator reading `.kpi/runs/<job>/stack.json` between gates sees the latest version only. The event log keeps the feedback and both approval decisions, so the history is reconstructible.

The select title carries a multi-line summary (bounded by PLAN_SUMMARY_MAX_MODULES = 12); the interactive selector already accepts multi-line titles (confirm passes `${title}\n${message}`), and RPC clients receive the same title string in extension_ui_request. There is no separate full-plan view: the dialog names the file path.

Feedback text is stored verbatim in the checkpoint and events.jsonl (redacted by redactJson for secret-shaped values), capped at MAX_HUMAN_FEEDBACK_CHARS = 4000. It is the operator's own words but it is durable run data.
Changing `submitHuman`/`resume` to HumanAnswer and deleting `GraphHumanUI`/`resumeWithUI` is a source-level API change for any external caller of the engine; none exists in this repository.

test/harness.test.ts compares src/kpi and dist/kpi byte-for-byte: forgetting the packages/coding-agent rebuild after editing the graph JSON or event.schema.json fails `npm run test:kpi` and `verify:built`.

`detail: "stack.json"` is a one-value literal on the human node. It is kept because the driver, not the node id, must know which run file to summarise, and validation refuses a second file until a renderer exists; a future gate over another file widens the union and adds a renderer in the same change.

rejected: 'the release-gate behaviour change in print mode is a product question' — the issue statement itself names the harness-answered gate as the defect and NEEDS_HUMAN-with-resume as the required behaviour; it is listed above as a visible change, not a choice.

rejected: 'MAX_HUMAN_FEEDBACK_CHARS / PLAN_SUMMARY_MAX_MODULES are surface nobody asked for' — AGENTS.md requires every failure mode to have a bound; an unbounded feedback string in a chained event log and an unbounded dialog title are the alternatives. The values are exported constants and named in the ACs so a product owner can change them; 'View full plan' and MAX_PLAN_VIEW_LINES were dropped as accepted.

rejected: 'move the dismissed-gate test to a shared helper module' — exporting fixture()/loopSessions/commandHarness from a new test helper adds structure for one consumer; the test lives in test/gated-loop.test.ts where the helpers already are.
open_questions: Should plan revisions share the plan node's run cap with verifier rounds (`--max-rounds`, default 3 runs = 2 change requests; `--max-rounds 1` allows none), or get their own limit (a new `maxPlanRevisions` on GraphBudgetLimits and task.limits)? The design uses the existing cap because it needs no new limit, flag, or schema field.

When a gated job is started with no dialog UI (print/RPC without a handler), should it be refused before it starts (matching the engine's stated policy for non-interactive graphs at engine.ts L409-411, saving the research/specify/plan spend) or run to the gate and stop NEEDS_HUMAN with the resume command (the issue's stated fix, and the only option for a job that was started interactively and resumed without a UI)? The design implements the latter only; refuse-at-start can be added as a check in runLoop without changing this design.

Product-owner sign-off on the US-02 story edit and the AC-02.8–AC-02.11 wording (in particular naming the operator gate 'plan approval' to keep it distinct from the Dune 'plan gate' of AC-30.4/AC-30.10).

problems.claim: The state.json `plan` object and the two gated-loop test assertions `state.json plan == {approved: true}` / `== {approved: true, feedback: ...}` are wrong: `values.plan` already carries `plan.provided`, so a deepEqual on {approved: true} fails as specified.
problems.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/kpi/extensions/gated-loop.ts L1272 returns `"plan.provided": planProvided` from the facts resolver on every resolve; engine.ts L1408-1418 refreshFacts does setStatePath per fact into values, and submitHuman (L1473) calls refreshFacts before routing. So after the gate `state.values.plan` is `{provided: false, approved: true[, feedback]}`. The design's event_or_data_contracts entry `plan: { approved?: boolean; feedback?: string }` and tests 1 and 2 (`state.json plan == {approved: true}`) would fail; they must assert `plan.approved`/`plan.feedback` individually or include `provided`.

problems.claim: Test 2's assertion 'stack.json on disk is the second plan's output' is not distinguishable with the fake session as it exists: loopSessions returns the same `options.stack ?? healthStack` for every plan run, and it records no prompts, so 'the second plan prompt (captured via the fake session)' also needs a harness extension the design does not specify.
problems.evidence: test/gated-loop.test.ts L171-178: plan/plan-check always set `lastAssistantText = options.stack ?? healthStack` (a single string, no per-run sequence); the factory pushes only node ids into `executed` (L166) and keeps no prompt array. commandHarness (L248-291) likewise has no prompt capture. The design's change list for test/gated-loop.test.ts adds `selections`/`answers`/`feedbacks` but nothing for per-run stack output or prompt capture.

problems.claim: open_questions is empty while the design silently makes several product decisions.
problems.evidence: (a) Plan revisions are bound by the same cap as verifier rounds (budget.ts L135-149, `--max-rounds 1` => zero change requests) — the design lists this only as a risk. (b) A gated job started without a dialog UI is allowed to spend research/specify/plan cost and then stall NEEDS_HUMAN at the gate; the engine's own comment (engine.ts L409-411) states the opposite policy for non-interactive graphs: refuse before a job starts rather than at the node. Refuse-at-start vs stall-with-resume is a product call. (c) MAX_HUMAN_FEEDBACK_CHARS=4000, PLAN_SUMMARY_MAX_MODULES=12, MAX_PLAN_VIEW_LINES=200 and a third 'View full plan' option are numbers and surface nobody asked for. (d) The US-02 story sentence is rewritten and four ACs are authored in the design; AGENTS.md: 'Do not invent requirements that are not in those files.' (e) The existing release gate changes behaviour in print mode (stub confirm→false→revise today; NEEDS_HUMAN after) — listed as a risk, not a question.
